☰ Track Guide

1. GenAI foundations

Understand model behaviour, prompts, APIs, context, structured outputs and common failure modes. Learn to test outputs instead of trusting them automatically.

2. RAG

Load documents, chunk them, create embeddings, retrieve evidence, and ground answers in sources. Evaluate retrieval and answer quality separately.

3. Agentic AI

Use tools, state, planning, routing, memory and bounded loops. Choose agents when dynamic decisions help; use a fixed workflow when the path is predictable.

4. LangChain + LangGraph

Learn model/tool integration, then use graph-based state, conditional edges, persistence and human approval to make complex workflows easier to control.

5. MCP

Learn how clients and servers expose tools and resources to compatible AI applications. MCP is a protocol, not a model or an agent by itself.

6. Production engineering

Test, evaluate, log, secure credentials, validate inputs, control tool permissions, expose APIs, and document deployment limitations.

How to learn: Concept → small code exercise → equivalent n8n workflow → test normal and failure cases → write a short reflection → commit useful work to Git.

♥ Healthy Routine

Editable and sustainable
Sleep first: Keep enough sleep and adapt study blocks around college and commuting. Do not sacrifice rest to finish a checklist.

🌅 Morning focus

Short review or one focused coding block if your schedule allows. Prepare for college without rushing.

🎓 College / travel

Use only suitable gaps for flashcards, reading docs, or reviewing notes. Take breaks when needed.

🌆 Evening build

Alternate coding and n8n workflow practice. Build small features rather than watching tutorials for the whole session.

🌙 Wind down

Record what you learned, set tomorrow’s priority, prepare your workspace, and keep a consistent bedtime.
